PROJECT CASE STUDY · MANUFACTURING ENGINEERING

Curve conveyor
productivity improvement.

A shop-floor improvement that replaced breakdown-prone turntables with taper-roller curve conveyors.

MATERIAL FLOW · VEPT
PROJECT IMPACT +4% OLE

Conveyor installation completed with zero downtime.

FOCUS AREAS

Taper rollers Pneumatics Gear mechanism Retroreflective sensors Project management

ROLE & TOOLS

Led the team that designed, developed, and commissioned the conveyor installation.

The challenge

Existing turntables were a recurring source of breakdowns and disrupted the movement of material through the production area.

What I worked on

Led a team to design and install taper-roller curve conveyors. The solution used a gear mechanism, pneumatics, and retroreflective sensors to support the required material flow.

Outcome and learning

The installation was completed with zero downtime and improved OLE. The project was selected among the best innovations in the Operations Innovation Challenge 2024.
